name: Tax Document
description: Structure for tax documents covering W-2, 1099, K-1, FATCA, and other IRS forms used in enterprise tax filing

fields.name: tax_year
fields.description: Tax year covered by the document

fields.name: issuer
fields.description: Entity issuing the document (employer, payer, partnership)

fields.name: recipient
fields.description: Individual or entity receiving the document

fields.name: amounts
fields.description: Key-value map of box names to dollar amounts

fields.name: boxes
fields.description: Structured list of named form boxes

fields.name: dates
fields.description: Issue date, period, and due dates

fields.name: box_number
fields.description: Box or line number on the form
